items.title: Modi in Karnataka: COSMOS Mysuru Planetarium a new chapter in India’s scientific journey, says PM | HIGHLIGHTS - The Hindu
PM’s address at the inauguration of COSMOS-Mysuru Planetarium in Mysuru, Karnataka

candidate_claims.text: Both these occasions convey a profound message about India’s values and our culture.
The University of Mysore was established during the reign of Maharaja Nalwadi Krishnaraja Wadiyar.
These institutions have provided generations of students and researchers with opportunities to advance.
Atal Ji added Jai Vigyan to it, and then I added Jai Anusandhan as well.
The India of the 21st century is moving forward with this very vision.
This year, Indian students achieved major successes in the International Olympiads as well.
This has been a record achievement for India.
Through Chandrayaan-3, ISRO made India the first country in the world to land near the Moon’s South Pole.
In the form of Aditya-L1, India has received its first solar observatory in space.
Friends, Our government opened up the space sector.
This created new opportunities for the private sector.
This is the scientific approach of a New India, where new discoveries are being encouraged, new technologies are being developed and new opportunities are being created for our youth.
This information is provided by the Real-Time Train Tracking System developed by Indian Railways and ISRO.
More than one crore students have so far benefited from the country’s over 10,000 Atal Tinkering Labs.
With this objective, we launched One Nation One Subscription.
It is now greatly helping the country’s educational and research institutions gain access to leading scientific journals from around the world.
We established the Anusandhan National Research Foundation.
Friends, Last year, we also launched a Research, Development and Innovation Scheme worth Rs.
1 lakh crore, so that our country’s researchers continue to receive adequate funding.
The children who come here to learn about the universe may well be among those who return here one day and tell us about the new discoveries they have made about the universe.
